title: LLMs won't break symmetric crypto
ai_summary:
• Large Language Models (LLMs) are ineffective in breaking symmetric encryption algorithms.
• Brute-force attacks still pose a significant threat to symmetric crypto systems.
• No LLM yet demonstrated capability to crack widely used symmetric encryption keys.
student_angle: Learning about current AI & ML developments, including attacks on LLMs, is beneficial for security-focused internships.
